meta.description: Corrects the gene-independent copy-number artifact in CRISPR-Cas9 screens with CRISPRcleanR, CERES, Chronos, and focal-amplification-aware diagnostics.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md
meta.n_inputs_note: Seven archived logical inputs were rerun as regressions; two fresh edge inputs exercised the new exact-source contracts.

scientific_integrity.detail: All numerical claims cited below came from the archived real HAP1/HT-29 program runs or clearly labeled synthetic edge construction; no clinical conclusion is made.

practice_boundaries.detail: The Skill retains its scope boundary and confines the workflow to analytical correction and hit-calling support.

methodological_ground.detail: The final reconciliation language now reports the demonstrated per-line residual and does not claim that pooled analysis must hide it.

code_usability.detail: The exact committed diagnostic function and Chronos construction error paths executed without undocumented behavior.

functional_suitability.note: CRISPRcleanR and Chronos routes, focal diagnostic, and error recovery are explicit and matched executed behavior.

reliability.note: Both omitted and empty negative-control failures are separately documented, and the pooled/per-line claim is bounded by evidence.

performance_context.note: The main Skill remains detailed but is supported by a separate usage guide and one focused example.

agent_usability.note: Decision routes, data orientation, minimum-panel constraint, low-power output fields, and reproducibility record are actionable.

human_usability.note: Failure modes and Common Errors provide cause-specific recovery steps.

security.note: No credentials, network mutation, or sensitive-data exfiltration path is introduced.

maintainability.note: The source has a small number of examples; external package behavior is versioned and explicitly named.

agent_specific.note: The new seed and manifest guidance makes reruns comparable while correctly declining a cross-platform bitwise guarantee.

inputs.label: REGRESSION: no-cry-wolf corrected control

assertions.text: All five controls remain below the low-power floor
No control is incorrectly suspicious
No control reports focal bias

inputs.label: REGRESSION: per-line versus pooled post-Chronos

assertions.note: Text instructs comparison without assuming concealment.

inputs.label: NEW: exact-source n=8 focal diagnostic

assertions.text: The extracted function executes

key_strengths: Exact-commit evidence covers both Chronos negative-control construction errors.
Low-power focal-bias behavior is checked on real residual data, false-positive controls, and threshold boundaries.
Reconciliation language now matches the observed per-line and pooled result without an unsupported universal claim.
Seed and manifest guidance makes Chronos reruns comparable while stating the platform limit.
